short: Ojibwe: the Great Spirit or Creator.
note: An English rendering of Ojibwe gichi-manidoo, “great spirit,” “god,” or “the creator.”

short: An extinct genus of large Asian apes.
note: A genus of extinct apes. Gigantopithecus blacki, known from fossil teeth and jaws in southern China, was an exceptionally large primate that disappeared during the Pleistocene.

sources.label: Zhang et al. · The demise of Gigantopithecus blacki

short: An American writer of California frontier tales.
note: The author of western stories such as The Outcasts of Poker Flat, whose use of California local color helped establish the American West as a major literary subject.

sources.label: University of New Mexico · Bret Harte: Opening the American Literary West
